name: Expired Reset Pass Link
description: Adds a configurable timeout for password-reset links.
project_description:
Add the expired password reset link timeout setting on the user settings page.

 CONFIGURATION 

 Goto: /admin/config/people/accounts

 INSTALLATION 

 - Install via /admin/modules

- composer require drupal/expire_reset_pass_link

- drush en expire_reset_pass_link -y

 CONFIGURATION BY SETTINGS.PHP 

change the user password reset link timeout in settings.php file

$settings['user.settings']['password_reset_timeout'] = 86400;
